test_metrics: test the metrics endpoint returns prometheus-formatted metrics with expected labels
test_parse_metrics: test parsing prometheus metrics text into a dictionary of metric names and float values
test_has_metric: test the has_metric utility to check if a metric with specific labels exists in a metric set
test_assert_env_var: test that PROMETHEUS_MULTIPROC_DIR environment variable is set before querying metrics
test_no_admin_metrics: test that admin-only metrics like queue_jobs_total are not exposed on the search endpoint
